caption: A soft ball is tossed in a gentle arc across a lawn and lands in a laundry basket standing on the grass.

sa.check: A laundry basket stands on grass.
The ball is tossed and travels through the air toward the basket.
The ball lands in the basket.
The toss is a gentle lob in an arc, not a hard throw.

pc.expect: In flight the ball follows one smooth curve that rises, peaks and falls; its sideways motion keeps going in the same direction until it lands.
pc.fail: The ball flies in a straight line at constant height; or hangs at the top of its arc; or changes direction midway with nothing touching it; or stops and then continues.

pc.expect: After the peak the ball descends, and once in the basket it stays down.
pc.fail: The ball rises again after starting to fall; or bobs up out of the basket with nothing pushing it; or drifts sideways over the basket without descending.

pc.expect: The soft ball rebounds little: it may flex on impact and settle; the basket stays rigid and at most rocks.
pc.fail: The ball bounces back out as high as it came in; or the ball flattens and stays flat; or the basket crumples or ripples like cloth under the ball.

pc.expect: The basket stays still until the ball arrives.
pc.fail: The basket slides or rocks before the ball reaches it; or moves toward the ball as if to catch it.

pc.expect: One ball, one basket; both keep their shape and identity, and the ball passes through neither the basket wall nor the ground.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes in flight or a second ball appears; or the ball turns into another object; or it passes through the basket wall or the ground.

pc.expect: The ball keeps its colour and size in flight; the basket and lawn stay unchanged.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour or size while in the air; or the basket changes pattern; or the lawn changes texture.
